lower.title: Lower Body + Steady Cardio
lower.focus: Leg strength, hip stability, and easy endurance.
lower.note: Weeks 1–2: keep every weight light and focus on feeling comfortable with each movement.

exercises.name: Zone 2 Cardio
exercises.details: Incline treadmill at 2–4% and 2.5–3.5 mph, or use a stationary bike. Keep a conversation pace without gasping.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.details: Hold a light dumbbell at your chest. Sit your hips back, gently drive your knees outward over your middle toes, and press through the outer edges of your feet as you stand. Stop at 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Press
exercises.details: Move with control, gently drive your knees outward over your middle toes, and keep a soft bend in your knees at the top—do not lock them out. Stop at 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.details: Sit back against the pad and push your knees outward with control. Stop at 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.details: Sit back against the pad and squeeze your knees inward together. Stop at 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.details: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot. Curl smoothly and return with control. Stop at 2 RIR.

upper.title: Upper Body + Incline Intervals
upper.focus: Back, shoulders, chest, and core—with a heart-rate boost.
upper.note: Rest 60–90 seconds between strength sets. Finish each set with 2 reps in reserve (RIR)—stop when you feel like you could do two more clean reps. There is no prize for rushing.

exercises.name: Incline Treadmill Intervals
exercises.details: Alternate 1 minute brisk at 6–8% incline and 2.8–3.5 mph with 1 minute easy at 1–2% incline.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.details: Pull the bar toward your upper chest and squeeze your shoulder blades together. Stop at 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.details: Keep your chest up and pull the handle toward your belly button. Return slowly. Stop at 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.details: Use light dumbbells—5–8 lb is plenty to start. Keep your shoulders away from your ears and your elbows soft, then raise your arms to shoulder height without swinging and lower with control. Stop at 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.details: Set the handles at mid-chest. Press smoothly and keep a soft bend in your elbows. Stop at 2 RIR.

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.details: Keep elbows under shoulders and make one long line from head to heels. Squeeze your core and breathe.

cardio.title: 30-Minute Treadmill Run/Jog
cardio.focus: A steady indoor run or jog to build midweek endurance.
cardio.note: Keep the treadmill at a 0.5–1% incline and choose a jogging pace you can sustain without gasping. Slow down whenever your form gets sloppy; the goal is steady work, not an all-out effort.

exercises.name: Treadmill Run/Jog
exercises.details: Warm up with a 5-minute brisk walk. Run or jog at a steady, conversational effort for 20 minutes, then cool down with a 5-minute easy walk. If needed, briefly reduce the speed to recover before returning to your jog.

recovery.title: Rest & Reset
recovery.focus: Walk, stretch, or just relax. Recovery is real training, too.

lower.title: At-Home Legs + Cardio
lower.focus: Bodyweight leg strength and hip stability after a quick indoor warm-up.
lower.note: No equipment needed. Start with the 5-minute jumping-jack warm-up. Rest 45–75 seconds between strength sets and stop each set while your form still feels clean.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack Warm-Up
exercises.details: Alternate 30 seconds of easy jumping jacks with 30 seconds of marching in place for five rounds. Keep your knees soft and land quietly; step side to side instead of jumping for a lower-impact option.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.details: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, sit your hips down and back, and keep your knees tracking over your middle toes. Press through your whole foot to stand. Keep a sturdy chair behind you as a depth guide if helpful.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.details: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg extended. Press through the planted heel, squeeze that glute, and lift while keeping your hips level. Lower with control and complete both sides.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.details: Stand tall, step one foot back, and lower both knees with control. Keep your front knee tracking over your middle toes, then press through your front foot to return to standing.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
exercises.details: Lie on your side with hips stacked. Lift the top leg without rolling backward, pause, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.details: Hold a wall for balance, rise onto the balls of your feet, pause at the top, and lower with control.

upper.title: At-Home Upper Body + Cardio
upper.focus: Back, chest, shoulders, and core after a quick indoor warm-up.
upper.note: No workout equipment needed. Start with the 5-minute jumping-jack warm-up and grab a folded towel for the floor lat slides. Choose a wall, counter, or couch arm that makes the push-ups feel smooth, rest 45–75 seconds between sets, and leave about 2 clean reps in reserve.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack Warm-Up
exercises.details: Alternate 30 seconds of easy jumping jacks with 30 seconds of marching in place for five rounds. Keep your knees soft and land quietly; step side to side instead of jumping for a lower-impact option.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.details: Place your hands on a sturdy wall, counter, or couch arm. Keep one long line from head to heels, lower your chest with control, and press away.

exercises.name: Superman Back Extension
exercises.details: Lie face down with your arms reaching overhead. Brace your middle, gently lift your arms and legs, squeeze through your back and glutes, then lower slowly. Keep the lift small and your neck relaxed.

exercises.name: Floor Lat Slides
exercises.details: On a smooth floor, kneel with a folded towel under your knees and start on all fours. Brace your core, slide your knees backward as your arms reach long, then pull your body forward using your lats. Keep your shoulders away from your ears and do not let your lower back sag.

exercises.name: High Plank Shoulder Tap
exercises.details: Start in a high plank from your toes with your hands under your shoulders and feet set wide for stability. Brace your core and tap the opposite shoulder without rocking your hips. Move slowly and keep a straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.details: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent. Keep your low back gently grounded as you extend the opposite arm and leg, then switch.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.details: Hold from your toes for as long as you can keep clean form. Keep your elbows under your shoulders, brace your middle, squeeze your glutes, and breathe steadily. Stop when your hips begin to sag or rise, then rest 60–90 seconds before the second hold.

cardio.title: At-Home Cardio Circuit
cardio.focus: Full-body conditioning with burpees, squats, jumping jacks, and core work.
cardio.note: Everything happens indoors with no equipment needed. After the warm-up, do 40 seconds of each circuit move with 20 seconds to transition. Complete four rounds, rest 60 seconds between rounds, then finish with 3 minutes of easy marching and stretching.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack Warm-Up
exercises.details: Alternate 30 seconds of easy jumping jacks with 30 seconds of marching in place for five rounds. Keep your knees soft and land quietly; step side to side instead of jumping for a lower-impact option.

exercises.name: Burpee (No Push-Up)
exercises.details: Squat down and plant your hands, jump both feet back into a strong high plank, immediately hop your feet forward, then jump straight up with your hands overhead. Keep your arms straight in the plank—there is no push-up.

exercises.name: Jump Squats
exercises.details: Lower into a controlled squat, drive through your feet, and jump straight up. Land quietly with soft knees and flow into the next rep only after you feel balanced.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.details: Keep a steady pace you can hold through every round. Land quietly with soft knees, or step one foot out at a time while reaching overhead.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
exercises.details: Start in a high plank from your toes with your hands under your shoulders and feet set wide for stability. Brace your core and tap the opposite shoulder without rocking your hips. Slow, controlled taps beat rushed reps.

recovery.title: Rest & Reset at Home
recovery.focus: Take an easy walk, stretch for a few minutes, or fully rest.
